title: Chinese prompt: number of days in a week
rationale: A wrong day count in a basic Chinese question silently corrupts scheduling and date arithmetic in Chinese-language products; this probe also anchors the cross-lingual consistency pair.

prompt.content: 你是一个精确的助手。请用简体中文、只用一个简短的句子回答，不要解释。

notes: Language: Simplified Chinese. Expected answer token: 7, accepted as the ASCII digit 7, the full-width digit ７, or the numeral 七 (as in 七天). Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0. Brittleness: an English answer such as 'seven' fails because the system message requires Simplified Chinese; the same fact is asked in Spanish by ml_cross_lingual_pair_01.
